# What will your Upstash Redis bill be, and should you go fixed?

> Estimate a monthly Upstash Redis bill from your own usage (million commands, storage GB, bandwidth GB) at editable list prices, see where pay-as-you-go crosses over to a fixed plan, and see which changes cut it most, with a dollar saving for each. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages
